# Check if there are multiple people with occupation "prison escapist"
escapist_count = df[df['occupation'] == 'prison escapist'].shape[0]

# Check if any of those prison escapists have status indicating they left the cube alive
alive_escapists = df[(df['occupation'] == 'prison escapist') & (df['status'].str.contains('alive', case=False, na=False))].shape[0]

# The statement requires both conditions: multiple prison escapists AND each left the cube alive
answer = (escapist_count > 1) and (alive_escapists == escapist_count)
